headline: Windows preview adds an easier way to silence Sticky Keys
summary: A new Windows preview build adds a 'don't ask again' option, and a direct checkbox, that lets users disable the long-running Sticky Keys accessibility pop-up without digging through Settings.

claims.statement: The Windows preview adds a 'don't ask again' option for the accessibility prompt, sparing users a trip through Settings.

sources.quote: Windows preview adds a 'don't ask again' option to accessibility prompts, sparing users a trip through Settings

claims.statement: A checkbox lets users simply turn the Sticky Keys pop-up off.

sources.quote: There's a checkbox that simply turns it off.
Windows 11 is finally adding an easier way to disable the Sticky Keys pop-up
